statement: This file freezes evidence requirements only; it is not execution evidence and cannot make an AC PASS.

required_observations: durable import job reaches a terminal state in both spatial profiles
network revision commits only after validation and materialization succeed
INP and GeoJSON counts, stable keys, geometry and issues round-trip
failed imports leave no network, revision, file or idempotency residue
raw multipart Windows drive, UNC, POSIX traversal and ADS names reach the server unchanged and return UNSAFE_PATH=422 before extension classification
truncated archives, bounded high-ratio zip input, deep JSON, duplicate stable keys and CPU or memory samples are rejected with frozen status and code
JWT algorithm, issuer, audience, expiry and role negative cases return 401
viewer writes return 403 and each rate-limit bucket returns 429 with Retry-After
network-job, simulation and calibration idempotency cover replay, conflict, expiry generation, concurrent active uniqueness and FK retention
filesystem, network and readiness signatures are unchanged before and after every rejected case
50-year 24-hour design storm runs through the real solver on four physical cores
worker wall time is at most 180 seconds for every repeat
289 persisted frames have monotonic timestamps, non-empty hydraulic content and checksums
quality and conservation checks pass without silent solver fallback
worker kill recovers a PostgreSQL lease and increments the fencing token
stale attempts cannot publish frames or results
timeout, cancel, retry backoff, attempt exhaustion and workspace cleanup are proven
API progress, cancellation and map timeline replay are reproducible
100 fake-clock slots and 30 real cycles produce auditable issued, origin and producer-published timestamps
every real cycle publishes within 180 seconds including P95 and maximum latency
probability calibration and forecast rule artifacts are resolved by ID, hash, validity and domain
PostgreSQL transactions enforce one active alert and one business event across concurrent workers
29m59s suppression, 30m boundary and observed-stage suppression are durable
authenticated canonical SSE replays exactly once across two workers and restart
producer outbox, relay publication, gap, resync, delivery retry and DLQ are atomic and auditable
every observation has immutable source event identity, payload hash and adapter version
external_verified trust is resolved by versioned policy rather than payload self-report
authentication, active device-network binding and good quality are independently evidenced
training, validation and test event splits are disjoint and persisted
baseline and calibrated candidates execute the pinned solver rather than derive predictions from observations
dataset, split, rainfall, solver, parameter, code and report hashes are reproducible
durable calibration lifecycle proves claim, lease, retry, timeout, finalization and report/metric atomicity
both A and B results are finalized by the real result repository
network revision, target manifest, rainfall, start, duration, interval and frame checksums match
every compared metric has explicit units and a frozen better direction
incompatible units, revisions, manifests and time grids return 409
absolute and relative deltas are independently recomputed, including zero baseline
comparison remains reproducible after API and worker restart
legacy REST status and response fields match versioned golden contracts
legacy SSE emits connected, sensors, alerts and system event names with stable payload fields
Last-Event-ID replays only newer events and survives reconnect
backend quality commands, startup and frontend legacy tests all exit zero
legacy characterization passes independently in postgis and portable profiles
postgis and portable run as two independent commands with fresh volumes
both profiles run migration, workers, API and SSE from pinned images
README demo completes in each profile
backup, volume destruction and restore complete in each profile
restored database hash and API probes match the pre-destroy evidence
both result artifacts have the same RUN_ID and commit and exit zero
